CREATE TABLE
D360.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_20251003_OPT_3
WITH (
 DISTRIBUTION =HASH([AAS_CUST_ID]),HEAP
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
EDS.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE='2024-09-10'


SELECT
AAS_AS_OF_DATE,
count(*)
FROM
EDS.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
GROUP BY
AAS_AS_OF_DATE
ORDER BY
AAS_AS_OF_DATE
